name: 能量吸收
desc: 选择自己场上表侧表示存在的1只怪兽。那只怪兽的攻击力·守备力直到结束阶段时上升对方手卡数量×200的数值。
faq: When "Hayabusa Knight", boosted by "Energy Drain", attacks, and the opponent's hand is reduced during the battle, the ATK of "Hayabusa Knight" for the second attack is not changed because the effect of "Energy Drain" is determined when "Energy Drain" resolves.
